mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_job_definition (id, job_code, job_name, description, cron_expression, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{jobCode}, #{jobName}, #{description}, #{cronExpression}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_job_definition SET job_name = #{jobName}, description = #{description}, cron_expression = #{cronExpression}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT id, job_code AS jobCode, execution_id AS executionId, status, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, items_processed AS itemsProcessed, items_converged AS itemsConverged, error_message AS errorMessage, created_at AS createdAt FROM iam_job_execution_log WHERE job_code = #{jobCode} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
